subject: [RFC PATCH v2 03/18] fuse: don't move a folio with PG_rcu_free into a fuse file

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Suggested removing fuse_try_move_folio() entirely and disallowing converting ordinary pages to folios and vice versa, as it would be required for future changes.

2026-11-04.patch_summary: The patch proposes to modify fuse_try_move_folio() to handle folios with PG_rcu_free by copying them instead of moving, addressing a potential double-put bug.

reviews.author: Linus Torvalds
reviews.summary: Agreed with David's suggestion and proposed removing fuse_try_move_folio() entirely, as well as pipe_buf_try_steal(), to simplify the code.
reviews.raw_body:
On Mon, 9 Nov 2026 at 06:46, David Hildenbrand (Arm) <david@kernel.org> wrote:
>
> Could we get rid of fuse_try_move_folio() entirely?

Please. That would be great.

              Linus

reviews.author: Linus Torvalds
reviews.summary: Proposed removing both fuse_try_move_folio() and pipe_buf_try_steal(), as they are not widely used and can be simplified out of the code.
reviews.raw_body:
On Mon, 9 Nov 2026 at 08:28, Linus Torvalds
<torvalds@linux-foundation.org> wrote:
>
> On Mon, 9 Nov 2026 at 06:46, David Hildenbrand (Arm) <david@kernel.org> wrote:
> >
> > Could we get rid of fuse_try_move_folio() entirely?
>
> Please. That would be great.

.. and in a similar vein, we should get rid of splice doing the same entirely.

Kirly's patch to just remove page_cache_pipe_buf_try_steal() entirely
(ok, it was originally mine, but Kiryl took ownership of that series:
"Tag, you're it") is worth doing, but I think worth doubling down on.
I think we sh ould just get rid of 'try_steal' entirely. I don't think
anybody really uses it. I think it exists in fuse and in the virtio
console, and neither is worth it.

Removing pipe_buf_try_steal() would basically remove all of
fuse_try_move_folio().

Conversely, removing fuse_try_move_folio() would make
pipe_buf_try_steal() even less useful than it is now.

Just remove them both. Good riddance.

                 Linus

2026-11-09.patch_summary: The patch proposes to modify fuse_try_move_folio() to handle folios with PG_rcu_free by copying them instead of moving, addressing a potential double-put bug.
